Description: Hartwell Industrial Holdings LLC is the family holding company for the Hartwell group, formed in 2001 to hold the members' interests in Hartwell Precision Manufacturing LLC and, since 2014, Hartwell Logistics LLC. The company has no independent operations; its assets are the equity interests in the two operating subsidiaries and the intercompany notes between them. Six administrative staff handle group treasury, insurance and consolidated reporting. Consolidated FY2025 group revenue of $92.4MM. Holdings is the corporate guarantor on all bank facilities of the operating company.

Description: Hartwell Precision Manufacturing LLC is a privately held precision machining and fabrication business serving aerospace, defence, heavy-truck and medical-device customers from two Indiana facilities. Founded in 2001 by James Hartwell, the company operates a 218,000 sq ft campus in Fort Wayne and a 140,000 sq ft plant in Kokomo currently under expansion. Capabilities include five-axis CNC machining, robotic welding, vacuum heat treatment and full CMM inspection. Certifications: AS9100D, ISO 9001:2015 and ITAR registration. 340 employees, of whom 265 are direct manufacturing. Revenue of $85.0MM for FY2025, up 9.4% year on year, with the top five customers representing 41% of sales. Banking relationship since 2012, managed from the Indianapolis commercial office.

Description: Hartwell Logistics LLC is the group's dedicated freight and distribution arm, formed in 2014 to carry finished goods from the Fort Wayne and Kokomo plants to customer sites across the Midwest and Southeast. Operates a fleet of 22 tractors and 41 trailers from the Kokomo yard with 38 employees, of whom 26 are drivers. Approximately 78% of revenue is intercompany, carrying Hartwell Precision freight; the balance is third-party backhaul. FY2025 revenue of $7.4MM. Hartwell Logistics is a related entity on the operating company's construction facility and is not a borrower or guarantor.
